criteria.silhouette_scale: Golden bread pieces and pale crumb show through a cream cloth wrap with brown tie. Matches bread-only recipe and differs from raw dough.
criteria.implementable_geometry: One static generated-item sprite; shape is complete within transparent margins.
criteria.mechanics_clearance: No moving mechanics; food and depicted container/wrapping form a coherent supported object.
criteria.period_materials: Natural food, earthenware, plain tin and cloth fit practical frontier/town kitchens; no decorative machinery.
criteria.family_consistency: Inspected against Cloth and fertilizer; broad pixel clusters, upper-left light and earthy palette are consistent.
criteria.controls_readability: No controls; ingredient state and silhouette identify this food.
criteria.gameplay_scope: No recipe, calorie, stack or container-return changes.

criteria.matches_direction: Golden bread pieces and pale crumb show through a cream cloth wrap with brown tie. Matches bread-only recipe and differs from raw dough.
criteria.geometry_uvs: Native generated-item JSON with 32x32 texture, 16 opaque colors, binary alpha and padded silhouette.
criteria.material_consistency: Food variation stays subordinate to shape; dough pale, baked bread warm, clay muted reddish brown.
criteria.assembly_interfaces: Existing registered item resource retained; no physical block interfaces.
criteria.animation_states: Static item with native held transform; no animation needed.
criteria.native_size_readability: Inspected family sheet at native size on dark/light backgrounds and enlarged. Comparable footprint and detail density; shapes remain distinct beside Cloth/fertilizer.

criteria.photon_materials: Inventory retains original natural palette; Photon framed views shade it consistently without missing textures or alpha boxes.
criteria.scale_readability: Golden bread pieces and pale crumb show through a cream cloth wrap with brown tie. Matches bread-only recipe and differs from raw dough.
criteria.states_motion: Static generated item. No animated or processing states apply.
criteria.interaction_guides: Food inventory item, no multiblock guide or placement interfaces.
criteria.inventory_appearance: Reviewed eight-item lineup: six kitchen items plus Cloth/fertilizer. Comparable scale, warm restrained palette, broad clusters and distinct silhouettes; pale uncooked preparations contrast golden ration bread. Bowl and pie have distinct depths and colors.
criteria.integration_limits: Build/unit and focused foods scene passed; inventory and frames inspected. Recipes/calories untouched; no gameplay or multiplayer coverage claimed.
